Static/WithCaps, pd::createTaskPreferPsram, std::thread/jthread) in src/ and main/; task_stack_gate.py fails when a file's site count differs from its entry count. 'entry' is a regex over the call-graph function name, and the worst match is budgeted. 'line' is a reference only. entry=null marks a site that is counted but not walked. 'variants' lists the esp_main files whose image links a row's code, when that is not every image; other images skip the row. 'only' names a Kconfig build feature (heap_trace) the site is compiled in; the entry is walked only when the gate gets --with <feature>, and must then be found.

_library_defaults: regex over a library callee's name (the first line of its .ci label) -> bytes charged when the .ci has no frame for it, from callees GCC never saw defined: prebuilt newlib, libgcc, libstdc++, ROM and HAL code. The first match in key order wins, so rows must not overlap (a test checks every name of the first CI run against exactly one). Every row states its figure and where it comes from in _library_defaults_reasons under the same key: a figure is measured only where its reason says so; otherwise it is an estimate of the callee's own frame plus the prebuilt code below it, which a static walk cannot see, and the runtime stackHwm_* stays ground truth. A reachable library callee with no frame, no match here and no frame_allowlist entry fails the gate. A row for a runtime hook GCC labels with a use site of ours states its reason too.

_library_defaults_reasons.^(?:int )?v?(s|sn|f|as)?printf\\b|^__bui: 2048 B, an upper estimate, not measured: newlib's printf family (prebuilt, no .ci) with float formatting; the deepest libc leaf this firmware calls. The first CI run charged http_conn's chain through snprintf (cdrarchive::formatLine -> formatRfc3339 -> snprintf) this figure, 2048 of its 4768 B.
_library_defaults_reasons.^void _ZTH5errno\\(\\)$: 0 B: GCC's TLS init hook for errno. Our objects reference it weak (nm: 'w _ZTH5errno' in libmain.a) and nothing defines it (not the toolchain's libc.a, not any IDF build archive), so it links to 0 and the TLS wrapper never calls it. It reads as ours only because GCC labels a callee it never saw defined with a use site.
_library_defaults_reasons.^int __cxa_guard_acquire\\(long long int: 1376 B, charged, not ignored: ESP-IDF's function-local-static guard (components/cxx/cxx_guards.cpp:113), labelled with a use site of ours. 1376 B is its worst direct chain over the IDF build's own .ci files (s3-eth leg, IDF v6.0.1): a first use creates the guard semaphore (static_init_prepare -> xQueueCreateCountingSemaphore -> xQueueGenericCreate -> heap_caps_malloc ...).
_library_defaults_reasons.^void __cxa_guard_(release|abort)\\(long: 752 B, charged: the same component (cxx_guards.cpp:170, :192); worst direct chain 752 B (signal_waiting_tasks -> xQueueGenericSend -> ... -> __assert_func).
_library_defaults_reasons.^Indirect Call Placeholder$: 0 B: not a function. GCC's node for an indirect call site, a call through a pointer or a vtable. The gate cannot follow indirect calls (module docstring), so the callee's frame is not charged: a known limit of a static walk, not a measurement. The runtime stackHwm_* stays ground truth.
_library_defaults_reasons.(?:^|[ *&])(?:memcpy|memmove|memset|memc: 128 B, estimate, not measured: prebuilt newlib/libc leaf routines (mem*, str*, ctype, __builtin_memchr, __builtin_ceil). They call nothing in the graph, so this stands for a small leaf frame with room to spare; the figure is a round one, not a measurement.
_library_defaults_reasons.^__[a-z]+(?:df|di|si)[0-9]?$: 128 B, estimate, not measured: libgcc's Xtensa soft-double and 64-bit integer helpers (__adddf3, __divdi3, __bswapsi2 and the like), prebuilt, leaves.
_library_defaults_reasons.(?:^|[ *&])(?:Cache_|rom_Cache_|cache_wr: 512 B, estimate, not measured: ROM code, HAL, FreeRTOS-port assembly and core-dump helpers that have no stack line in the .ci (esp_rom_*, ets_sha_*, Cache_*, wdt_hal_*, xt_ints_*, vPortYield, esp_core_dump_checksum_*, esp_timer_get_time, one mbedtls clone). The largest are ROM printf, ROM MD5 and the register save of vPortYield; 512 B is a round figure chosen to sit above those, not a measurement.

_library_defaults_reasons.(?:^|[ *&])(?:sin|strtod)(?:\\(|$): 1024 B, estimate, not measured: newlib strtod (big-integer helpers) and libm sin (argument reduction plus soft-double calls), prebuilt.
_library_defaults_reasons.(?:^|[ *&])(?:fopen|fclose|fread|fseek|f: 1536 B, estimate, not measured: newlib stdio and descriptor calls (fopen, fread, fclose, fseek, ftell, fputs, remove, select, _close_r, _fcntl_r, _rename_r) end in the IDF VFS and FatFs through function pointers, which a static walk cannot follow; this figure stands for that driver chain. The stackHwm_* of the tasks that open files is the check.

A throw on a small stack is a gap in this model that only a run with stackHwm_* closes.

_recursion_allowlist: desmo 2026-10-02: any cycle reachable from a walked task fails unless it has a row here. Key: a substring of one member's demangled name (a row names one cycle, a cycle takes one row). depth: the most live activations any one member can have, derived from a constant in the code and shown in reason. The cycle is charged depth x the sum of its members' frames, once, in every chain through it. A test (test_checked_in_recursion_bounds_follow_the_code) recomputes the derivations from JsonReader.hpp, PoolConfig.hpp and partitions.csv, so raising one of those constants fails it until the row is re-derived. Frames and members are from the Xtensa eth image, main 4e56650. The rows for code outside this repo (cJSON, lwIP, IDF, mbedtls) come from CI run 39346846761 and cite the IDF file read (v6.0.2-838 on the machine that wrote them; CI builds v6.0.1); no test can pin them to the code, so re-check them when IDF, mbedtls or the cjson component is bumped. The two cJSON rows are CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT + 1, with the limit set in the top-level CMakeLists.txt (test_cjson_recursion_rows_are_the_nesting_limit_not_a_guess reads it).
_indirect_allowlist: #1031 review. A task row marked "indirect": "bounded" (tel_sweep: the 911 orphan sweep; tel_ctl: tel_ctl0/tel_ctl1, tel_drop, tel_sos; sip_server and sip_server_task: the SIP server loop) fails unless every function it reaches that makes an indirect call (a vtable, std::function, a callback pointer; GCC names every such site by one placeholder node, so a site is its caller) matches a row here. Key: a regex searched in the caller's demangled name. targets: regexes over function names; the gate adds an edge from the caller to every function a regex matches, in the walk of the marked tasks only, so the heaviest target chain is charged. [] means no target exists in the image. reason: who installs the pointer or which overrides exist, with file:line. A target that matches nothing, or a key no indirect caller matches, fails. Limits: the targets are the mechanisms read in each class's own source; an indirect call inlined from a header of another class is not seen, and the open sets (pthread key destructors, esp_netif tcpip_exec users beyond the app's) are not charged. stackHwm_* stays ground truth. A call site is a placeholder edge that carries a call position (file:line:col, printed as `at:` in the gate's report); a placeholder edge without one is a block operation (a memset/memcpy libcall for an aggregate initializer or copy), charged as memcpy and needing no row. Rows are per function; a key that is a class prefix would give every method every target, so the PbxEnv, SipTrunk::Listener, nvs and esp_transport rows name the method. Where a row cites ESP-IDF, the source read is v6.0.2-838; CI builds v6.0.1.
